evals.prompt: 这个 Expo + pnpm monorepo 已经能在 Expo Go 中运行，帮我打出一个能直接发给测试同事安装的安卓包。项目在 E:\work\MenuPicker。
evals.expected_output: Detects an Expo Managed/CNG project, defaults to an installable Debug APK, checks JDK/SDK, preserves any generated native project, builds and verifies the APK, and reports its path.

evals.prompt: React Native 项目在 Windows 上 assembleDebug 报 CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX，接着给我打 APK，不要改新架构配置。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the Windows pnpm/CMake path-length failure, uses a short temporary workspace with a hoisted pnpm install, preserves the original checkout, and returns a verified APK.

evals.prompt: 请把这个 Android Gradle 工程打成 Google Play 能上传的 aab，并顺手发布到 Play Console。
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes this release/publishing request from a default Debug APK build and asks for explicit signing and publishing authorization instead of publishing automatically.
